lead_independence.headline: Martin County Animal Services responded to Palm City hoarding home roughly 20 times since 2020
lead_independence.lead: Martin County Animal Services had a long history of responding to complaints involving Paige O'Donnell's residence on Southwest Alligator Street, with roughly 20 related incidents documented from 2020 through this year before deputies executed a search warrant Monday that resulted in the rescue of 36 Border Collies. One 2020 investigation documented about 25 dogs and described the home as severely unsanitary, with feces and urine covering the floor. Investigators said one elderly dog was in such poor condition that humane euthanasia was recommended.
